title: Model catalog quant defaults: policy, calibration pipeline, and accuracy gates
creator: Asha Nair
description: Deliver a defensible, auditable policy and automation pipeline that assigns per-model recommended quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) in the model catalog and enforces accuracy guardrails via a CI validation suite. Output is: 1) catalog fields 'quant_recommended' and 'quant_risk' for each model; 2) automated calibration job that produces candidate profiles; 3) validation metrics and a pass/fail gate used by catalog publish workflows. Must support divergent model families (decoder-only, encoder-decoder, embedders) and be safe for hosted and dedicated deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog shows a recommended quant profile (or 'no-recommendation') per model for FP8 and INT8 with rationale metadata
Automated calibration jobs (batch) produce deterministic quant profiles given seed and dataset reference
Validation suite runs in CI and enforces numerical gates: <=0.5% relative degradation in embedding cosine, <=0.5 perplexity increase or delta <=1% on task metrics depending on model family
Rollout automation tags model as 'recommended' / 'experimental' / 'blocked' and prevents 'recommended' label if validation fails
Documentation for the calibration process, datasets, hyperparameters, and known failure modes published in Confluence and linked from the catalog entry
implementation_plan: Design: finalize policy doc with metric thresholds and tag semantics (recommended/experimental/blocked)
Calibration: implement containerized calibration worker that runs per-model profiling, activation/wt ranges, per-layer FP8 vs INT8 decisions, and export profiles to storage
Validation: build CI job that replays calibration profiles against holdout eval sets and compares against float baseline metrics
Catalog integration: extend model metadata schema with 'quant_recommended', 'quant_profiles', 'validation_report_url' fields and UI flags
Rollout: small-batch catalog update with manual review for first 20 models, then automated for low-risk classes
calibration_workflow: 1) Pull model weights and float baseline traces for representative sequence lengths; 2) Run activation range collection on a curated calibration dataset (1000-5000 examples depending on model size); 3) Try a prioritized set of quant schemes: FP8-e4m3, FP8-e5m2, INT8 symmetric, INT8 per-channel asymmetric; 4) For each scheme perform a quick NLL/perplexity and embedding similarity check against baseline; 5) Keep top-K candidate profiles sorted by cost estimate and accuracy delta; 6) Persist profile artifacts and leaderboards to S3 and write metadata to catalog; 7) Trigger full validation job. Notes: dataset provenance, seed, and quant seeds are recorded for reproducibility.
validation_suite: Float baseline run and storage of reference metrics (perplexity, top-k accuracy, embedding centroids)
Calibration replay: apply profile and recompute metrics on holdout eval set
Downstream probes: instruction-following A/B on 200 curated prompts for LLMs, and retrieval/semantic-sim benchmarks for embedders
Statistical comparison: bootstrap confidence intervals and threshold checks; fail on >0.5% relative embedding cosine drop or >1% relative downstream accuracy drop
Performance checks: verify memory and peak GPU utilization savings estimates match profiling within 15%
rollback_guardrails: If validation fails or model drift is detected in production, automatic rollbacks are enforced: catalog label reverted, serving routes shift to float variant or previous recommended profile, alerts to SRE and product. Guardrail thresholds are configurable per-customer; default is conservative: disable INT8 for models with high customer-sensitive classification accuracy (customer_impact: high).
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - internal: run on internal benchmark models and validate pipeline stability (2 weeks)
Phase 1 - advisory release: set 'experimental' recommendations for a curated set of open models and collect telemetries (4 weeks)
Phase 2 - controlled auto-recommend: for low-risk embedder models, enable automatic 'recommended' label with nightly revalidation (6 weeks)
Phase 3 - wide release: enable catalog defaults for broader model classes with monitoring and canary traffic routing
notes: Trade-offs considered: FP8 often gives better compression but is more sensitive to outliers; INT8 gives predictable kernel support on more hardware. We prefer FP8 for decoder-only LLMs where kernels are optimized and INT8 for large embedder models on dedicated capacity.

Calibration dataset: initial curated set combines LaMDA-style prompts, instruction-following prompts, and proprietary telemetry where allowed. Must get legal sign-off for telemetry usage before including customer data.
Open question: static per-channel vs dynamic range calibration for attention kv caches. Action: spike (ENG-15890) to evaluate dynamic clipping impact.
